prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Meowscarada (마스카나) personified, grass / dark type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the whole scene for this frame; Framing below sets how much of her shows.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Her source may add one small accent at most — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as the scene settings below describe, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera, so her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head; her eyes, not her whole face, swing toward the camera.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: mouth smiling while the eyes stay flat and unsmiling, brows level, gaze direct and unwarm
Pose: Stand at ease with relaxed shoulders and naturally balanced feet.
Orientation: rear three-quarter view with natural equipment depth and occlusion; the head turns no more than a quarter turn, face in profile or three-quarter
Scene: The broad velvet staircase rises toward cinema spotlights and polished brass balustrades.
Outfit and props: A strapless deep-green gala gown with a short sculpted front hem and a sweeping long rear train, baring the shoulders and legs; smooth satin defines a formal silhouette.
Category: Show a public gala or red-carpet moment: arriving on a red carpet, posing at a photo wall, a film-festival staircase, an award ceremony, a gala dinner, a charity auction, a fashion-week front row. A show-stopping evening gown or couture look — high slits, open backs, plunging or one-shoulder necklines, trains — with event lights and flashes. Photographers and guests stay blurred in the background; no real event names or logos.
Example scene: climbing a grand red-carpeted staircase at a film festival in a gown with a long train
Framing: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: subtle — one restrained source-color accent or small accessory
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.
